04Frequency

Creator variants wear out after three exposures

Creator-led variants peak at the second exposure and lose a third of their predicted CTR by the eighth. Brand voice starts lower but holds steady, so the gap closes at roughly six exposures.

Fig 02 Predicted CTR (%) by exposure frequency. Source: Socialtrait simulation, 2026-10-02
Insight

Cap creator variants at three impressions per person and rotate in a fresh cut; the media plan should budget for two creator refreshes across the flight.

05Method

How this study was run

Panel
Calibrated persona models across 4 segments · 2,400 simulated respondents per variant
Variants
3 creator-led · 3 brand voice, final cuts as supplied 2026-09-28
Exposure
Randomized order, in-feed context, 1–8 exposures · 14,400 exposures total
Calibration
Client first-party engagement data through 2026-08
Caveats

Findings are simulation-derived predictions. Validate the top variant in a 5% media holdout before full rollout.
